paper_title: First results from a hidden photon dark matter search in the meV sector using a plane-parabolic mirror system
suggested_experiment_name: Tokyo plane-parabolic mirror dish antenna (Tomita et al., phase 1)
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing chi, dimensionless, as plotted on y-axis of Fig. 5 (left), virialized four-bin analysis
notes: First dish-antenna (plane + parabolic double mirror) haloscope limit on hidden photon dark matter in the meV region. Paper excludes chi >~ 1e-8 at 90% CL over 0.67-0.92 meV; encoded as an approximately flat two-point line since only Fig. 5 (unreadable here) contains the detailed stepwise structure spanning roughly 1e-8 to ~1e-7 across sub-regions.
